name: LiteLLM API
description:
Proxy Server to call 100+ LLMs in the OpenAI format. [**Customize Swagger Docs**](https://docs.litellm.ai/docs/proxy/enterprise#swagger-docs---custom-routes--branding)

👉 [```LiteLLM Admin Panel on /ui```](/ui). Create, Edit Keys with SSO. Having issues? Try [```Fallback Login```](/fallback/login)

💸 [```LiteLLM Model Cost Map```](https://models.litellm.ai/).

🔎 [```LiteLLM Model Hub```](/ui/model_hub_table). See available models on the proxy. [**Docs**](https://docs.litellm.ai/docs/proxy/ai_hub)

💬 [```LiteLLM Chat UI```](/ui/chat). ChatGPT-like interface for your users to chat with AI models and MCP tools.
